audience: anyone who follows sports a little
summary: An easy, clean daily: the four US leagues and the Premier League come at once, La Liga, the Bundesliga, Serie A and MLS decide the score, and Ligue 1 is the one stretch. The IPL at #12 is the best near miss.
reasons: Casual found 7 to 10 over three 15-guess runs (an American who skips soccer 7, a mixed player 9, a Brit 10), so about 8: the top of the daily band. Lives go only on near misses (WNBA #36, IPL #12). A fan swept it in 12.

Fair and clean: F1, UFC, NASCAR, the Champions League, the World Cup and college sports are free; the IPL, Brasileirao, Liga MX and Saudi Pro League cost a life and show a figure. Category words alone (football, basketball, soccer, baseball, hockey, rugby, cricket, league, sports) offer only leagues past #10 or nothing; only the partial names "premier" and "liga" offer a top-10 answer, as a did-you-mean.

Fun is modest: the halves split by audience, but few surprises past the IPL and MLS above Ligue 1. Nov 12 would be the third sports daily in a week (World Series Nov 6, Olympic medals Nov 7) and three days before athletes-earnings (Nov 15), against the owner's call for variety: run it a week clear of those.
fixes: "spanish league", "english league", "german league", "italian league" and "french league" each name a top-10 league but the game says they aren't answers: add them as aliases of La Liga, Premier League, Bundesliga, Serie A and Ligue 1 in topics.ts, and "brazilian league" and "saudi league" to the Brasileirao and Saudi Professional League.

"serie a brazil" offers Italy's Serie A as a did-you-mean: add "Serie A Brazil" to Campeonato Brasileiro Serie A. "league 1" is not recognized: add it to Ligue 1 and EFL League One (two owners, so both are offered).

Two names lost their sport in the build: "Super League" (#91) is rugby league and "Women's Premier League" (#83) is the source's "Women's Premier League (cricket)" (WPL). Rename them "Super League (rugby league)" and "Women's Premier League (cricket)", add "WPL", so a player who meant another Super League learns which one cost the life.
"a league" and "a-league" (A-League Men, #90) are never recognized: the queued normalize() leading-"A" item in docs/REBUILD_QUEUE.md.
